source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of thermoregulation in humans (PDF 8-9).

blocks.text: Insaan endothermic homeotherms hain, yaani apni hararat khud banate hain aur darja-e-hararat ek jaisa rakhte hain. Yeh negative feedback mechanism se jism ka darja-e-hararat qaboo karte hain. Maslan jild mein maujood thermoreceptors jism ke darja-e-hararat ka barhna ya girna pakarte hain. Yeh control centre yaani hypothalamus ko signal bhejte hain; hypothalamus mein bhi thermoreceptors hote hain. Hypothalamus muscles aur glands ko signal bhejta hai jo halat theek karne wala jawab (corrective response) dete hain, maslan:

Jab jism ka darja-e-hararat 37°C se barh jata hai to vasodilation hota hai: jild ki khoon ki nalyan khul jati hain. Asal mein jild ki capillaries ko khoon pohanchane wali chhoti arteries (arterioles) chauri hoti hain, jis se epidermis ke bilkul neeche wali capillaries mein zyada khoon behta hai aur khoon ki zyada hararat jild se bahar nikal jati hai. Jawab mein paseena (sweating) bhi shamil hai. Paseena bhap ban kar urta hai (evaporation) to jism ki hararat saath le jata hai aur thandak paida karta hai. Thyroid gland thyroxine hormone ka ikhraj kam kar sakta hai, jis se basal metabolic rate (aaram ki halat mein metabolism ki raftar) kam hoti hai aur jism ke andar hararat kam banti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke vasodilation mein jild ki capillaries khud phailti hain. Capillaries ki deewar mein muscle nahin hota, is liye woh khud nahin phailtin. Asal mein un ko khoon dene wali arterioles chauri hoti hain, jis se capillaries mein zyada khoon behta hai aur zyada hararat jild se nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Hum garmi ya thand kaise mehsoos karte hain
blocks.text: Thermoreceptors dimagh ke upar wale markazon (higher centres) ko bhi signal dete hain. Is liye hum garmi ya thand ko 'mehsoos' karte hain. Is se hum mazeed qadam utha sakte hain, maslan nahana, ya pankha ya heater chalana.

Jab jism ka darja-e-hararat 37°C se gir jata hai to jawab mein vasoconstriction, kaampna (shivering) aur metabolism ki raftar ka barhna shamil ho sakte hain. Vasoconstriction mein jild ki taraf khoon ka bahao kam ho jata hai, is liye khoon se kam hararat zaya hoti hai. Kaampna (skeletal muscles ka jhatkon se sukarna) hararat paida karta hai jo jism ka darja-e-hararat barhane mein madad deta hai. Baalon ki jar (hair follicles) ke chhote muscles sukarte hain aur rongte khare ho jate hain (goosebumps). Khare baalon mein hawa phans jati hai jo hararat ke liye insulator (hararat ko rokne wali tah) ka kaam karti hai. Metabolism ki barhi hui raftar bhi hararat paida kar ke jism ka darja-e-hararat barhati hai.

blocks.alt: See-saw 'Body Temp. 37 C (homeostasis)' ke gird do chakkar. Upar wala: darja-e-hararat maamool se barhta hai; jild aur hypothalamus ke receptors pakarte hain; hypothalamus ka control centre effectors yaani paseena (sweat production) aur vasodilation ko chalata hai; darja-e-hararat maamool par aata hai. Neeche wala: darja-e-hararat girta hai; receptors pakarte hain; control centre vasoconstriction aur kaampna (shivering) chalata hai; darja-e-hararat maamool par aata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.5: Insanon mein thermoregulation (kitab ki Figure 13.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har chakkar stimulus wale dabbe se 'Receptors (in skin & hypothalamus) detect stimulus' aur 'Information sent to control centre.' se hota hua dimagh tak jata hai jis mein hypothalamus hara nishan hai, phir effectors aur response wale dabbe tak. Garmi ke effectors: jild ka tukra jis mein lipta hua paseene ka ghadood (sweat gland) aur sath par qatra hai, 'Sweat production: Cooling by evaporation.'; aur jild jis ki khoon ki nalyan sath ke qareeb phaili hain aur hararat ke teer nikal rahe hain, 'Vasodilation: Heat radiated from skin surface.'. Thand ke effectors: jild jis ki nalyan patli aur gehri hain, 'Vasoconstriction: Blood diverted to deep tissues to minimize heat loss.'; aur skeletal muscle ke reshe, 'Shivering in skeletal muscles: Heat produced.'.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar wala chakkar garmi ka hai aur neeche wala thand ka. Dono ki tarteeb ek jaisi hai: stimulus (tabdeeli), receptors, hypothalamus ka control centre, effectors, phir response jo darja-e-hararat ko 37 C par wapas laata hai. Garmi mein paseena bhap ban kar (evaporation) jism thanda karta hai, aur jild ki nalyan phail kar (vasodilation) hararat bahar nikalti hain. Thand mein nalyan sukar kar (vasoconstriction) khoon andar bhejti hain taa ke hararat kam zaya ho, aur muscles kaanp kar (shivering) hararat banate hain. Kitab ne 'Cooling by evaporates' aur 'increases than normal' chhapa hai; matlab 'evaporation' aur 'normal se zyada' hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 13.5 mein 'Cooling by evaporates', 'increases than normal' aur 'decreases than normal' chhapa hai. Sahi alfaz 'Cooling by evaporation', 'above normal' (normal se zyada) aur 'below normal' (normal se kam) hain, jo khaake mein likhe hain.

blocks.prompt: Darja-e-hararat 37 C se barhne par insanon ki qaboo ki tadabeer bayan kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Jild ke thermoreceptors hypothalamus ko signal dete; jild ki capillaries phailti hain to zyada hararat nikalti, paseene ke glands paseena banate jis ki bukhaarat jism ko thanda karti, aur hararat kam karne ke liye thyroxine ka ifraz kam ho sakta hai; saye mein jana ya pankha chalana bhi madad deta hai.

items: Insaan negative feedback se darja-e-hararat qaboo karte hain; control centre hypothalamus hai.
Garmi: vasodilation (arterioles chauri, jild mein zyada khoon), paseena, thyroxine kam.
Thand: vasoconstriction, kaampna, goosebumps, metabolism tez.
Dimagh ke upar wale markaz hamein garmi ya thand mehsoos karwate hain, to hum pankha ya heater chalate hain.
